components_chart_ff: A minified Chart.js Scale helper related to orientation-aware sizing (isHorizontal).
components_chart_fn: A minified Luxon helper used when setting date-time values and computing days in a month.
components_chart_formatdurationfromstrin: Luxon function that formats a Duration according to a given token format string.
components_chart_generateticklabels: Chart.js legend plugin method that generates the label text and styling for each legend/tick item.
components_chart_getanims: Chart.js Animator internal method that retrieves the set of active animations for a target.
components_chart_getaxis: Chart.js BarController internal method that determines the index axis (x or y) used by a bar chart.
components_chart_getbasepixel: Chart.js BarController method that computes the pixel position corresponding to a bar's base value.
components_chart_getlabelsize: Chart.js Scale internal method that computes the pixel size of a single tick label.
components_chart_getmaxborderwidth: Chart.js BarController method that determines the maximum border width across a dataset's visible bar elements.
components_chart_getringweightoffset: Chart.js DoughnutController internal method that computes the radial offset for a ring based on dataset weights.
components_chart_getstacks: Chart.js BarController internal method that collects the set of stack identifiers used by matching visible dataset metas.
components_chart_gettimestampsfortable: Chart.js time-scale internal method that builds the lookup table of timestamps used for value/pixel conversion.
components_chart_getweeksettings: Luxon Locale method that returns week-related settings such as the minimum days in the first week and the start-of-week day.
components_chart_gm: A minified Luxon helper related to computing UTC offsets for the current time.
components_chart_h: A minified Chart.js helper that retrieves the canvas rendering context.
components_chart_has: Chart.js internal helper that checks whether an animation or option scope exists for a target.
components_chart_he: Chart.js internal method that draws a dataset and its labels onto the canvas.
components_chart_hi: Chart.js color helper that darkens or saturates a color and returns its hex string representation.
components_chart_interpolate: Chart.js animation helper that interpolates between two values (numbers, colors, or objects) for a given progress fraction.
components_chart_isvalidzone: Luxon Zone method that checks whether a given IANA time zone specifier is valid.
components_chart_jc: A minified Chart.js helper used when rotating chart elements.
components_chart_kc: Chart.js color helper that converts a color to an HSL string representation.
components_chart_kf: Chart.js interaction helper that handles chart events using point-label context lookups.
components_chart_ki: Chart.js Scale internal update method that computes pixel positions for values based on user-defined bounds.
components_chart_ks: Chart.js Scale internal method involved in computing label rotation during layout.
components_chart_ku: Chart.js Scale helper that computes pixel positions for values depending on axis orientation.
components_chart_lo: Chart.js color class helper that converts a color object to an RGB representation.
components_chart_ls: Chart.js Scale class responsible for computing grid line and label items and fitting the scale into the layout.
components_chart_months: Luxon Locale method that returns the list of month names (long or short) for the locale.
components_chart_mu: A minified Chart.js layout helper related to computing padding.
components_chart_on: Luxon DateTime helper used when constructing a DateTime from an object and setting its zone.
components_chart_onclick: Chart.js legend plugin default click handler that toggles a dataset's visibility (show/hide) when its legend item is clicked.
components_chart_parseformat: Luxon Formatter internal method that parses and expands a format token string for date/time/duration formatting.
components_chart_pathsegment: Chart.js helper that builds an SVG/canvas path segment for a line or area element.
